name: Karen Bieman
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I specialise in intimate partner betrayal trauma. I am particularly passionate about helping straight spouses who are struggling to come to terms with the discovery that their partner is LGBT. I also work with grief and loss, including non-death losses such as relationship endings, separation and divorce.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery

name: Trish Thompson
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I have been a counsellor for 26 years, and have worked in community settings and private practice. I have also facilitated a number of different therapy groups, and have taught in the Bachelor of Counselling degree at ACAP. My approach to working with clients places the collaborative relationship at the forefront, as we work together to attend to the difficulties that interfere with living a fulfilled life.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Sex and sexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery

name: Tania Ciotti
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Tania is credentialled as an Accredited Mental Health Social Worker, (AASW) Accredited Social Worker (AASW), Registered Counsellor (PACFA), and Accredited & Certified Supervisor (PACFA, AAOS), whose extensive professional experience, 30+ years, as a bilingual-bicultural practitioner, spans the breadth of Social Work fields of practice, private practice and tertiary education. Tania draws from a critically-reflective and person-centered framework, her practice experience includes: counselling, complex case-management, research, project work, casework, therapeutic group-work, supervision, community development, and consultancy across a breadth of scopes of practice: child & family, aged care & older persons, disability, carers, palliative care, mental health & wellbeing, bereavement, death & dying, chronic illness, EOL, family violence, settlement and migration, grief & loss, and trauma across the lifespan. Tania utilizes a range of evidence-based theoretical and therapeutic approaches including: Psychodynamic Relational/Attachment Practices, Developmental Theories, Acceptance and Commitment Therapy, Person-Centered Approach, Systems Theory, Interpersonal Therapy, Solution-Focused Th
specialties: Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Somatic Experiencing, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Louis Spence
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Louis offers ongoing individual psychotherapy to people of all kinds, and specialises in working with LGBTQIA+ people and their families, people in non-normative relationships, workers in the sex industry, and others whose experiences of marginalisation have affected their mental health and access to affirmative treatment. They hold a Masters of Psychotherapy and Counselling and a Bachelor of Arts, and are PACFA Accredited. Their psychotherapeutic education was built upon a framework of Person-Centred Therapy, and they draw on training in Emotion-Focused Therapy, Focusing, Existential Psychotherapy and Cognitive Behaviour Therapy among others, depending on the specific needs and goals of each client.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Sex and sexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: James Wright
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: We all feel overwhelmed at times. It’s a normal, human response to the pressures of modern life. Yet constantly feeling anxious or burned out is a sign that something is out of balance.
specialties: Sex and sexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery

name: Ilana Laps
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I am a Melbourne-based psychotherapist and dream analyst trained in 30yrs of Western and Eastern approaches to mental health and healing. My own explorations of human consciousness are complimented by all I’ve learned from my clients, who have been my most important teachers. My years in the chair have taught me things beyond what I learned in my extensive studies (though I remain a lifelong learner and philomath).
specialties: Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Claudia Allison
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: I am a Counsellor and Psychotherapist who works from a wholistic, trauma-informed, social justice framework. I believe that each client is unique and individual and I use a client-centred approach. Areas I am particularly interested in are self-esteem and self-growth, trauma healing, managing anxiety and gender and sexuality exploration.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues

name: Niloufar Sadjady
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Psychosexual Therapy, Sexual Health Couple counselling, Sexuality and relationship coaching, life coaching
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Transgender, Gender Identity and Intersex issues, Trauma recovery
